mentions.name: Kubernetes From the Problems Up
mentions.description: A course that teaches Kubernetes by posing each chapter as the evolution of a startup experiencing a problem and showing how Kubernetes solves it, with the reader cast as the technical manager in the situation. It focuses on the high-level details and motivations of Kubernetes rather than being super in-depth, and was built with the help of Claude Opus.
mentions.audience: Aimed at people who want to understand Kubernetes at a high level, framed for the technical manager perspective
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been learning kubernetes with the help of Claude Opus and trying to build it into a course which others might find useful: https://gravitypersists.github.io/kubernetes-from-the-problems-up/
mentions.author: gravity13
